county_canvass: First day to canvass Nov 9, 2026; Board of Supervisors deadline Nov 19, 2026 (NCSL: 'No later than the third Thursday after a general election')
recount_rule: Automatic: Less than or equal to 0.5% of the votes cast for both candidates or on a ballot measure (NCSL). Maricopa plan: ~Nov 19 - Dec 4, 2026 if needed.; Requested: No requested recount process (court may order one) (NCSL).

county_canvass: No counties; final regional count of absentee/questioned ballots 11/18/2026; State Review Board begins 11/19/2026 (NCSL local canvass: 'Day after election')
state_certification: Target date 11/25/2026 (NCSL: 'Upon completion of the state ballot counting review')
recount_rule: Automatic: Tie vote (NCSL); Requested: A defeated candidate or 10 qualified voters (NCSL); application deadlines 11/28/2026 (Governor/Lt. Gov, 3 days) and 11/30/2026 (5 days) per Division calendar.
rcv_note: RCV tabulation follows the last count on the 15th day after Election Day (Nov 18, 2026 computed). A repeal initiative is on the Nov 2026 ballot per Ballotpedia News; effect on this election not stated by sources.

county_canvass: By noon on the 13th day after the election (Nov 16, 2026 computed)
state_certification: Election Canvassing Commission meets 9 a.m. on the 14th day (Nov 17, 2026 computed)
recount_rule: Automatic: 0.5% of the votes cast on the office or measure; completion by 3 p.m. on the ninth day after the election (NCSL); Requested: No requested recount process (NCSL)

county_canvass: 5 p.m. on the Monday following the election (Nov 9, 2026 computed)
state_certification: NCSL lists only presidential-elector timing (governor certifies by 5 p.m. on the 18th day); general state certification date not captured
recount_rule: Automatic: NCSL lists GA in its automatic table: 'Less than or equal to 0.5% of the total votes cast for the office.' CONFLICT: Verified Voting (2024) says no automatic recount.; Requested: Losing candidate may request when results are within 0.5% of total votes cast for the office (NCSL; Verified Voting: within 2 business days after certification).

state_certification: Not later than 27 days after the election (Nov 30, 2026 computed)
recount_rule: Automatic: None listed (NCSL); Requested: Candidates on the ballot may request; commissioner must order a recount if margin is less than 0.15% for statewide/federal office, or less than the lesser of 1% or 50 votes for other races (NCSL). 2024 practice: request by 5 p.m. on the third day after the county canvass.

state_certification: Dec 1, 2026: 'Last day for State Board of Canvassers to certify official results'
recount_rule: Automatic: None listed (NCSL); Requested: Any candidate; for ballot measures, any registered elector who voted (NCSL)

county_canvass: Municipal returns by 5 p.m. second business day after election (NCSL)
state_certification: Within 20 days after the election (Nov 23, 2026 computed)
recount_rule: Automatic: Tie vote (NCSL); Requested: Apparent losing candidate (NCSL); in RCV races only a top-three candidate at the end of the penultimate round, within five business days after results are announced (ME SoS).
rcv_note: RCV used for U.S. Senate and ME-2 (not ME-1) in Nov 2026; central tabulation in Augusta; ~10 days if needed (FairVote, 2026-10-20).

county_canvass: No later than the 14th day after the election (NCSL) (Aug 2026 primary precedent: counties certify 14 days after)
state_certification: NCSL: not later than the 40th day after the election; Aug 2026 primary precedent: Board of State Canvassers certified 20 days after (by Aug 24)
recount_rule: Automatic: 2,000 votes or less in a statewide primary or election (NCSL); Requested: Candidate alleging fraud or mistake in the canvass may petition (NCSL); within 48 hours of the state canvass (Verified Voting 2024)

state_certification: State Canvassing Board begins third Tuesday after the election (Nov 24, 2026 computed); no end date specified (NCSL)
recount_rule: Automatic: None listed (NCSL); Requested: A losing candidate whose name was on the ballot (NCSL)

county_canvass: 8 a.m. on the day following the election, unless SoS orders otherwise (NCSL)
state_certification: When the time for a recount or appeal has expired (NCSL)
recount_rule: Automatic: None listed (NCSL); Requested: Any candidate if margin is less than 20% of the total votes cast in the towns comprising the office (NCSL)

county_canvass: On or before the 10th day after the election (Nov 13, 2026 computed)
recount_rule: Automatic: None listed (NCSL); Requested: A defeated candidate at any election; any voter for ballot questions (NCSL); within 3 business days after certification (Verified Voting 2024)

county_canvass: 11 a.m. on the 10th day after the election (Nov 13, 2026 computed)
state_certification: Not more than 10 days after the Tuesday three weeks after Election Day (by Dec 4, 2026 computed)
recount_rule: Automatic: None listed (NCSL); Requested: Statewide: margin of 0.5% or 10,000 votes, whichever is less; non-statewide: 1% (NCSL); request by noon on the 2nd business day after county canvass (Verified Voting 2024)

county_canvass: No later than 21st day after the election (Nov 24, 2026 computed)
state_certification: Not later than 10 days after abstracts received from all counties (NCSL); OH SoS Directive 2026-48 covers the Nov 3 canvass (not readable here)
recount_rule: Automatic: 0.25% or less for statewide office or issue; 0.5% for other offices (NCSL); Requested: Any candidate who received votes; groups of 5+ voters for ballot questions (NCSL)

county_canvass: Not later than the 27th day after the election (Nov 30, 2026 computed)
state_certification: Not later than the 30th day after the election (Dec 3, 2026 computed)
recount_rule: Automatic: Tie vote, or not more than 0.2% of the total votes for both candidates (NCSL); Requested: A candidate or party officer on the candidate's behalf; an elector for ballot measures (NCSL)

county_canvass: No later than noon on Saturday following the election (Nov 7, 2026 computed)
state_certification: Board of State Canvassers convenes within 10 days of the election (NCSL)
recount_rule: Automatic: Less than 1% of total votes cast for the office (NCSL); Requested: No requested recount process (NCSL)

county_canvass: Not later than the 14th day after the election (Nov 17, 2026 computed)
state_certification: Not earlier than the 18th or later than the 33rd day after the election (Nov 21 - Dec 6, 2026 computed)
recount_rule: Automatic: Tie vote (NCSL); Requested: Candidates if margin is less than 10% of votes cast for that candidate, among other conditions (NCSL)

county_canvass: No later than 14 days after the election (Nov 17, 2026 computed)
state_certification: No later than the first day of December (Dec 1, 2026)
recount_rule: Automatic: None (NCSL); Requested: Any aggrieved candidate (NCSL); margin <= 0.25% = taxpayer-funded recount, >0.25% and <1% = paid recount (Verified Voting 2024)

county_canvass: Unofficial results due by 5 p.m. the Tuesday after the election (Nov 10, 2026 computed); final five days later if no recount/recanvass (NCSL)
recount_rule: Automatic: 0.5% or less of votes cast for statewide candidates and ballot questions (NCSL; PA DOS confirms 0.5% statewide trigger); Requested: Any three qualified electors filing a petition alleging fraud or error (NCSL)
